realReviews.author: Tim Rak
realReviews.text: Outstanding work by Jose and his team. We had water damage from a leaking AC drain pipe within the wall of our primary bedroom. The walls had already been mitigated for mold/moisture but he took care of everything else. In just two days, drywall, texture, paint, base boards, and crown molding all taken care of and looking like no problem had every existed. Highly recommend!

realReviews.author: Randy Toombs
realReviews.text: Jose owner of J&B remodeling personally did the update on my kitchen backsplash, and hung my vent hood. He was professional, and consistent with getting my project done. No long gaps of time from start to finish like many people deal with. Only gap was what was needed was for certain cements to dry, and cure! Once that was done he was right on it. I will have him do future remodeling projects I have planned!

realReviews.author: Delia
realReviews.text: Jose and Cesar did a phenomenal job on our new shower! The shower was gutted and everything put back new. They installed new porch columns, replaced front and back doors along with screen doors. They replaced siding and installed gutters and security light. Great job and highly recommend Jose!!
